name: Consultation
summary: We talk through what you need it for, how you want it to look, and what budget makes sense.
body: Every order starts with a conversation, not a form. In your consultation we discuss the occasion, how the garment fits into your existing wardrobe, and any references you've brought — photos, fabric swatches or a piece you already own and love.
We'll walk you through fabric options in person, explain construction choices (like canvas vs. fused for jackets), and give you a clear price and timeline before anything is cut.
Consultations happen in-atelier or over a video call for clients ordering remotely; fabric swatches can be posted ahead of a virtual session.

seo.title: Consultation — Our Process
seo.description: The first step at Lipek Fashion: a fabric, fit and budget conversation before anything is measured or cut.
